summary_md: **恒星sun ([@vintcessun](https://x.com/vintcessun/status/2116345418774876226))** summarizes *Decode-Time Provenance Binding for MCP* ([arXiv 2610.31974](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31974)). Untrusted sources are tagged with cryptographic labels when MCP decodes them, and a lineage ledger blocks tainted sensitive actions, taking attack success from 100% to 0%. This holds only if every data flow goes through MCP.
